scripts.ingest:verify: npx tsx -e "const {Pinecone}=require('@pinecone-database/pinecone');const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const lines=fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(),'.env.local'),'utf-8').split('\n');const env={};for(const l of lines){const[k,...v]=l.split('=');if(k&&v.length)env[k.trim()]=v.join('=').trim();}const pc=new Pinecone({apiKey:env.PINECONE_API_KEY});pc.index(env.PINECONE_INDEX||'nexus-knowledge').describeIndexStats().then(s=>console.log('Vectors in nexus-knowledge:',s.totalRecordCount));"
